question: What is the unit price of the product with SKU SKU-0012?
goldSql: SELECT unit_price FROM products WHERE sku = 'SKU-0012'

question: How many cities are in the Makkah region?
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities ci JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Makkah'

question: Which employees are sales reps located in Khamis Mushait? Give their names.
goldSql: SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities c ON c.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'sales_rep' AND c.name = 'Khamis Mushait' ORDER BY e.name

question: What was the total delivered revenue from retail customers in Q1 2025?
goldSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'retail' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-04-01'

question: كم إجمالي إيرادات الطلبات المسلّمة من عملاء شريحة الجملة في النصف الأول من 2024؟
goldSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'wholesale' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01'

question: Which sales channel had the highest average order value for delivered orders in Q4 2025?
goldSql: SELECT label FROM (SELECT o.channel AS label, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS metric FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY metric DESC, label) LIMIT 1

question: What were the top 3 products by total margin in Q3 2024, where margin is line revenue minus quantity times product cost, delivered orders only? List product names, highest first.
goldSql: SELECT label FROM (SELECT p.name AS label, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost), 2) AS metric FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-10-01' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY metric DESC, label) LIMIT 3

question: Which region had the lowest year-over-year growth in delivered revenue comparing first-half 2025 with first-half 2024? (A decline is lower growth than any increase; do not use absolute change.)
goldSql: SELECT label FROM (WITH r AS (SELECT rg.name AS region, CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01' THEN 'a' ELSE 'b' END AS y, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions rg ON rg.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND ((o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01') OR (o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01')) GROUP BY rg.name, y) SELECT a.region AS label, (b.rev - a.rev) / a.rev AS metric FROM r a JOIN r b ON b.region = a.region AND a.y = 'a' AND b.y = 'b' ORDER BY metric ASC, label) LIMIT 1
